retryPlan.title: Retries
retryPlan.description: How a failed message is tried again: Short, Standard, Long, or Custom with your own waits.

retryWaits.title: Custom waits (minutes)
retryWaits.description: With Custom: the minutes to wait before each retry, for example 2, 10, 60.

templateLanguage.title: Language of your Meta templates
templateLanguage.description: The language code your WhatsApp templates are approved in at Meta, for example en, en_US, es or ur (empty: en). A template's own language version (Multi-language templates) goes in its language as Meta writes it, for example pt_BR for pt-BR.
